collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.
collection.description: During a dry spell, the spring above the village slows to a trickle and a long line forms before dawn.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: During a dry spell, the spring above the village slows to a trickle, and a long line of villagers with water jars forms before dawn.

choices.label: Ask Who Needs Water Most Urgently.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Everyone leaves with a little water, and nobody walks home with an empty jar.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The first few households are satisfied, but the line moves so slowly that several people give up and return at midday.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Households take turns filling jars after dark, and the morning line shrinks to almost nothing.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The night turns are tiring, and the group agrees to try them only until the rain returns.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A family with a feverish elder is filled first, and nobody in line objects.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Several households say their need is urgent, and the villagers decide to share equally after all.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Two villagers remove fallen leaves and silt, and the trickle runs a little stronger.

d2__fx.name: Outcome D2
d2__fx.text: The clearing makes no difference, but the workers learn where the water truly rises.
